in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit name शुभन् (Shubhan) is derived from the Sanskrit root word शुभ् (shubh), which means auspicious, fortunate, excellent, or propitious. The name is often used to describe something or someone that brings good luck or success.
